Package org.jwcarman.who.core.service

package org.jwcarman.who.core.service
  • Class
    Description
    LastCredentialGuard
    Keeps an identity from losing its last sign-in credential.
    Resolution
    The outcome of WhoService.resolveDetailed(Credential): either the resolved principal or the reason the credential did not resolve.
    Resolution.Inactive
    The credential is linked to an identity that is not active.
    Resolution.NoIdentity
    The credential is linked to an identity that does not exist.
    Resolution.NotLinked
    The credential is not linked to any identity.
    Resolution.Resolved
    The credential resolved to an active identity.
    SignInCredentialCounter
    Counts one kind of sign-in credential an identity holds.
    WhoService
    Core service that resolves a Credential to a WhoPrincipal.
    WhoSessions
    who's record of browser sessions: one per sign-in, so a person can see where they are signed in and end a session from elsewhere, and an application can end an identity's sessions.
